captureMethod: Three original browser frames from one fresh run, in order; 2 seconds per frame is reading time, not measured transition timing. Login, workspace creation, deployment-managed page and token entry are omitted.
realDependencies: Spring authentication and workspace services, PostgreSQL, credential encryption and rotation CAS, Next.js production build, Caddy and synthetic local Git.
mockedBoundary: Integration-only RepositoryConnections fixture replaces provider metadata and credential verification. No request or credential is sent to GitHub or CNB.
flow: Created managed workspace shows its fixed repository address and empty rotation form
Invalid synthetic token produces actionable error and clears both inputs
Accepted synthetic replacement produces success and updated timestamp, with both inputs cleared
limitations: Mocked Git provider verification does not prove real GitHub/CNB credentials or network interoperability. Local HTTP only; no production HTTPS acceptance. Required integration tests cover anonymous, outsider and member denial; these are not shown in this owner browser run.
